title: Token / non-card component
description: Physical components that aren't cards: tokens, dials, boards, standees, dice. Same stable-ID discipline; same diffability. Files: components/tokens.json array. (Genre door-opener: a wargame unit tray or a worker meeple is a row here too.)

per_player.description: Quantity is per player rather than total.

symbol.description: If this token backs an inline text symbol, the symbol key from game.yaml (e.g. 'spark').

attributes.description: Game-specific fields, same convention as cards.

parent.description: Optional hierarchy (FUTURE-GENRES bucket 1): OOB formations, nested components. References another token id.

faces.description: For kind 'die': custom face definitions (TTS RotationValues / TTPG custom dice precedent).
